name: NFL week 6 · October 18–19, 2026
note: Fixed pregame forecasts selected on October 17 ET. This forward test never replaces its predictions with later forecasts. Minutes 1–60 of regulation; kickoff and overtime excluded. Final scoring feed required before grading.

forecast.note: Experimental context script; not validated as an improvement. Experimental pregame estimate, not a live win-probability model. Scores are expectations, not a predicted exact scoring sequence. Scoring timing blends own scoring and opponent concession profiles; totals come from the existing game-context model. Independent Poisson scoring events: 70% seven points, 30% three points, constant rate within each quarter. No possession, drive or overtime simulation; probabilities are uncalibrated.
